pages.title: Overview
pages.text: The Beast is a heavy Illager unit with 80 health, strong melee attacks, and a cost of 5 recruitment slots. Its blows launch targets upward.$(br2)Right-click a Beast with a Villager Soul to restore 25 health.

pages.name: Beast
pages.text: They do not attack Illagers, Raiders, their creator or players with a Raidborn alliance effect.

pages.title: Summoning the Beast
pages.text: Place a Beast Heart with a Carved Pumpkin directly above it. Place Mud directly below the Heart and on two opposite sides. Put a Chest directly against either remaining horizontal side; the two side Mud blocks must be perpendicular to the Chest.$(br2)The Beast faces away from the Chest.

pages.title: Ownership
pages.text: A player-created Beast remembers its creator and never attacks them. The creator can right-click it to open a 15-slot inventory.$(br2)Beasts can be led with a Lead. Stored items drop when the Beast dies.

pages.title: During Raids
pages.text: Beasts appear in raids at the same frequency as Ravagers. A raid-spawned Beast arrives leashed to a Pillager or Vindicator and carries a modest shipment of vanilla weapons, ammunition, food, and camp supplies.$(br2)The automatic raid leash releases during combat and can reconnect after combat. Its cargo remains available if the Beast is recruited.
